lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 4? Nope!

lines.text: One-foot square tiles: forty blue on the edge, eighty white inside.
lines.caption: One-foot square tiles: 40 blue on the edge, 80 white inside.

lines.text: How many feet longer is it than it is wide?
lines.caption: How many feet longer is it than it is wide?

lines.text: That's one hundred twenty tiles. Now count each floor's edge.
lines.caption: That's 120 tiles. Now count each floor's edge.

lines.text: Sixty by two: one hundred twenty edge tiles. Forty by three: eighty-two.
lines.caption: 60 by 2: 120 edge tiles. 40 by 3: 82.

lines.text: Then less and less: sixty-four, fifty-four, forty-eight, forty-two.
lines.caption: Then less and less: 64, 54, 48, 42.

lines.text: Twelve by ten gives exactly forty, with ten by eight inside!
lines.caption: 12 by 10 gives exactly 40, with 10 by 8 inside!

lines.text: Twelve minus ten: two feet longer!
lines.caption: 12 minus 10: 2 feet longer!

lines.text: Four was the trap: nine by thirteen falls three tiles short.
lines.caption: 4 was the trap: 9 by 13 falls 3 tiles short.

lines.text: Did you get two? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 2? Tell me below!
